findings.spec: FR-24; Security and privacy: sign-up rate-limited per IP and per email
findings.summary: Sign-up was rate-limited per IP only; sign-ups for one email from many IPs emailed that owner without limit.
findings.verification: failing route test: 6th sign-up for one email from a new IP returned 200 (expected 429)

findings.spec: FR-24: same response whether or not the email has an account
findings.summary: Sign-up for a new email also inserts the business/account and emails the operator, so it takes longer than for an existing email; response time may reveal whether an email has an account.
findings.reason: not measured against real Resend latency; a complete fix sends sign-up emails from a job queue (not built)

findings.summary: Passwords use node:crypto argon2 (Node 24.7+). package.json has no engines field; on Node 22 every hash throws TypeError (verified: 10 tests fail on Node 22.23, all pass on 24.22). CI uses Node 24.
findings.reason: the production Node version is a Vercel project setting the owner controls; confirm it is 24.x or add engines.node >=24.7 (owner decision)

findings.summary: 'A password change or reset ends all other sessions': the reset ends account sessions and inbox sessions opened from the account, but not inbox sessions from emailed sign-in links (owner_sessions.account_id null). The SPEC does not say whether those count.
Other unused reset and verify links stay valid after a reset (each is still single use and expires); recommend revoking them on reset.
The breached-password check fails open when Have I Been Pwned is unreachable (marked as a shortcut in code); the SPEC says passwords are checked. Owner decision.
Setting owner_accounts.disabled_at does not end inbox sessions already opened from that account.
The sign-in screen has no 'email me a sign-in link' option, and a signed-in owner is not sent straight to the inbox ('/' is the landing page; /account lists locations). Still listed as Partial.

Landing mock-up text does not name the business (FR-7 requires real texts to); pricing says data is 'deleted on request' while the SPEC says everything within 30 days of offboarding. Marketing copy, not code.

FR-24 and Flow 0 say nothing is imported until the business is live, but Flow 1 step 4 loads a first CSV before step 5 switches it to live. importCsv/pollSheet do not check business status (sends do). Owner should pick one.
The Implementation status table still says FR-24 Not implemented after #28; open PR #32 (SPEC sync) appears to address it.
